name: NASA Earthdata Search
license: varies by collection; verify collection-level terms before ingestion
provenance_notes: Primary discovery catalog for NASA Earth science observations. Collection metadata must remain attached to imported evidence.
limitations: No NASA data is claimed to be physically imported into World Lab by this registry entry.

name: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information Web Services
license: source-specific; verify dataset terms and attribution requirements
provenance_notes: Programmatic access path for NCEI observations and climate datasets; retain dataset and station identifiers in evidence records.
limitations: Some Climate Data Online API calls require an access token.

name: OpenStreetMap
access_method: regional extracts, APIs, and bulk data
temporal_scope: continuously updated; historical extracts require separate sources
provenance_notes: Attribution and share-alike obligations must be preserved for derived database use.
limitations: Coverage and completeness vary by place and feature; OSM is not a uniform census of the physical world.

name: World Bank Data Catalog
license: dataset-specific; catalog metadata/API documentation is separately licensed
spatial_scope: country, regional and subnational where available
provenance_notes: Use dataset-level metadata, citation and version information when converting observations into evidence.
limitations: Not every dataset is directly comparable across countries or years.

name: Mesa
provenance_notes: Reference implementation for ABM patterns, scheduling, visualization and analysis. Review selectively; do not copy code without license and compatibility review.
limitations: World Lab is not being replaced by Mesa; this is an external architecture reference.

name: Mesa-Geo
provenance_notes: Reference for spatial ABM/GIS integration and geospatial model patterns.
limitations: No source code has been imported into World Lab from this entry.

name: PCMDI Metrics
provider: Program for Climate Model Diagnosis and Intercomparison
domain: climate and Earth system model evaluation
provenance_notes: Reference for quantitative evaluation of climate and Earth-system model outputs.
limitations: Metrics must be selected and adapted to World Lab's variables and uncertainty model.

name: FLAME GPU 2
provenance_notes: Reference for GPU-accelerated ABM architecture and performance. Licensing requires explicit review before any code reuse.
limitations: No FLAME GPU code is imported into World Lab by this registry entry.
